facts.raw_span: A 48-year-old white man
lifelong non-smoker
remote bronchoscopic resection of a tracheal carcinoid 17 years earlier
three-month history of mild hemoptysis
cough without dyspnea

oxygen saturation of 94% on room air

polypoid lesion in the precarinal tracheal region adjacent to the anterior wall
mass arising from the anterior tracheal wall just above the main carina, causing an 80% obstruction of the right main bronchus and 70% obstruction of the left main bronchus
tumor consisted of large nests of eosinophilic cells within a collagenous and myxoid matrix
carcinoid tumor was initially suspected
